1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Three short stacks and three trinket types make one small cabinet with little occlusion.
1.natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. In Full interaction click the visible top curio in the cabinet; in Simplified interaction click an exposed curio in the visible EXPOSED PICKS proxy. Three matching curios disappear together; seven unmatched curios lose. Do not use code, scripts, Developer Tools, console, DOM, page state, terminal, address-bar edits, reloads, navigation, extensions, or external applications.
